interface.shortDescription: Scaffold and preview feature tech specs.
interface.longDescription: Tech Spec scaffolds structured feature specifications — decisions, API contracts, implementation details, and quirks — then serves a live HTML preview for review and iteration. Specs are organised one folder per feature, one file per concern.
defaultPrompt: Open a live preview of the spec.
